item.title: Sudbury mom uses baseball bat to keep young man away from her daughter
item.description: Ayden Martin simply couldn't follow various court orders that he not have any contact with his girlfriend in 2025 and January of this year. His attempts to contact her led to situations where Martin assaulted the girlfriend's father, Martin, himself, getting struck by a baseball bat by the girlfriend's mother, and ultimately, a 41-day stay at the Sudbury Jail.
